label: Confirm order
hint: Issue this march order. Fee: {fee} gold
notes: owner 2026-09-27: after the destination click, the order waits for COMMIT or CANCEL (ArmyOrderMenu, the confirm menu); the order rides by courier (spec 2026-09-27-courier-core), but owner 2026-09-28: 不要说发送信使，就是确认命令即可 — the row only confirms the order

label: Cancel
notes: the confirm menu's other row; clicking away from the menu does the same

label: Edit route…
hint: Bend its route, add waypoints, or change the load
notes: owner 2026-09-27: 行进路线commit后，再次点击终点可以edit路线或者cancel操作 — the route menu, opened by a click on a march's end ring

label: Cancel march
hint: Send a courier to halt the column where it has got to
notes: the route menu's other row: an ARMY_GARRISON, owner 2026-09-27: the order rides by courier (spec 2026-09-27-courier-core)

hint: Pause the clock to plan a march
notes: owner 2026-09-27: 兵人行进路线只能在暂停模式下选择 — the reason MARCH, Edit and Cancel march are greyed out while time runs

label: Commit march
hint: Send the fleet along this route
notes: final review 2026-09-28: a fleet takes no courier yet (CourierSystem.carries_orders), so its COMMIT keeps the pre-courier words

label: Cancel march
hint: Halt the fleet where it has got to
notes: final review 2026-09-28: a fleet's Cancel march, no courier

label: Pencil it in
hint: A draft: no courier and no fee until the council's resolutions are sealed
notes: WAR ROOM v2 C (owner 2026-10-02, spec 2026-10-02-war-room-v2 §3.1): in the war room COMMIT plants a draft (ArmyOrderMenu.drafting)

label: Cancel march
hint: Pencil a halt: it rides when the council's resolutions are sealed
notes: WAR ROOM v2 C (spec §3.1): the war room's Cancel march is a garrison draft too — every order given in the room waits for the seal

label: Strike the draft
notes: WAR ROOM v2 C (spec §3.1): the route menu over a regiment with a draft (a draft pennant, or a march with a pencilled halt)

label: Take the seat
hint: Send a courier: this unit enters the town, the one inside takes its camp

label: Garrison the town
hint: Send a courier: this unit enters the empty town

label: Add waypoint
hint: Keep this point and click where the march goes next; drag the line to bend it
notes: owner 2026-10-07 (spec 2026-10-07-march-waypoints): the confirm panel's third button — 除了Confirm和Cancel，再加一个Add waypoint选项

hint: A march takes at most {max} waypoints
notes: spec 2026-10-07-march-waypoints ruling 3: Add waypoint greyed out at army_march_waypoints_max
